_note: B15 village post office: mail, packages and delivery nouns. Natural scenes with people using the objects; English sound-alike hooks acted on each item.

fr_envoyer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe, the village ENVOY, SENDS a paper-plane letter flying and shouts "YAY!" (ahn-vwah-YAY).
fr_envoyer_verb.why: Envoy + yay → envoyer = to send. The future is irregular (j'enverrai). Irregular: GOLD beret.

fr_emailler_verb.why: E-MAIL → émailler = to enamel; to pepper (Des fautes émaillent son texte). RED beret = regular -er. Wave 1b oct30: moved from st_ingenieurs/verriers into poste/cour; hook rewritten to match the new painting.
